newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kimmon sees 97/98 earnings falling on FTC action.
newsitem.headline: Kimmon sees 97/98 earnings falling on FTC action.

text.p: Kimmon Manufacturing Co Ltd said on Wednesday its earnings for the business year starting in April would be affected by recent action taken against it by the Fair Trade Commission (FTC) over suspected bid-rigging.
The Tokyo-based maker of water and gas meters said in a statement that it may be barred from bidding for contracts awarded by public institutions for a certain period.
The government's anti-monopoly watchdog on Tuesday filed a complaint with prosecutors against 25 firms, including Kimmon, over suspected bid-rigging.
The FTC said the firms were suspected of pre-arranging winners of contracts for water gauges awarded by the Tokyo metropolitan government.
The company said the FTC's action would have an impact on its business results for the current business year but the extent of it was still uncertain.
